page: Microsoft Azure FX96-48mds_v2 is an x86_64 server instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The virtual machine provides 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor. A core characteristic of this configuration is its high memory footprint, featuring 1832.0 GB of system RAM, which provides 38.17 GB of memory per core. The server does not include GPU accelerators.

For local disk requirements, the instance integrates 5670 GB of fast NVMe SSD storage, alongside support for Premium Storage tiers. Complementary public IPv4 addresses are not included with the virtual machine. Because this instance constrains the active compute footprint to 48 vCPUs while retaining a memory pool and local storage capacity typical of larger host allocations, it delivers cost efficiency for software platforms licensed on a per-core basis.

This hardware profile is tailored for large-scale enterprise databases, in-memory caching systems, electronic design automation (EDA), and heavy transactional workloads requiring high memory capacity and fast local scratch storage without licensing full 96-core topologies.
